name: Journey A: CRM changes since Monday shortlist
description: On Monday, shortlisted 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team. User asks if any changed pricing or shipped something big since.

historySeed.content: We need to shortlist 5 CRM tools for our 20-person sales team. Criteria: contact management, pipeline automation, and under $50/user/month.

Here is the shortlist of 5 CRM tools for your 20-person sales team:
1. HubSpot Sales Hub Starter: $20/seat/month.
2. Pipedrive Standard: $24/user/month (annual).
3. Zoho CRM Standard: $14/user/month.
4. Close CRM Starter: $49/user/month (annual) or $59 monthly.
5. Freshsales Growth: $9/user/month.
All 5 meet your pipeline automation and budget requirements.

prompt: On Monday we shortlisted 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team. Has any of them changed pricing or shipped something big since?
passCriteria: Exact 5 CRM tools recovered from historical conversation on Monday 9 November

name: Journey B: Historical recall plus fact-check (3 November)
description: On 3 November, user asked about vector database hosting. User asks what they asked on 3 November and if the answer is still correct today.

historySeed.content: What are the serverless vector databases available with free tiers?
Pinecone provides a free starter index with up to 100k vectors. Qdrant Cloud offers a free 1GB cluster. Turbopuffer charges usage-based search with an initial credit.

prompt: What did I ask you on 3 November? Is your answer still correct today?
passCriteria: Accurately quotes original question from 3 November
Summarizes original assistant answer accurately
Searches current sources to verify volatile claims
Gives per-claim status: still supported, changed/differing, or not verifiable
Distinguishes answer differences from confirmed effective change dates

name: Journey C: Postgres hosting prices since Last Tuesday
description: Last Tuesday (Nov 3), discussed Supabase, Neon, and Crunchy Data Postgres hosting plans. User asks if pricing changed since.

historySeed.content: Compare Neon and Supabase Pro for a dedicated database with 8GB RAM.
Supabase Pro is $25/month base including compute credits. Neon Scale is $69/month plus compute unit hours ($0.16/CU-hour). Compute and egress overages apply to both.

prompt: Last Tuesday I asked you about Postgres hosting. Has any pricing changed since?
passCriteria: Resolves Last Tuesday as Tuesday, 3 November 2026 in user timezone
Recovers exact providers (Supabase, Neon) and baseline plan numbers
Searches current official pricing pages
